headline: Fintech Operator OPay Expands Digital Financial Inclusion Drive in Nigeria
summary: Digital payments provider OPay is deploying its merchant agency network and mobile transaction tech to broaden financial service accessibility across Nigeria.
why: OPay is a dominant financial technology platform in West Africa, competing in the rapidly growing mobile money and digital merchant services market.

impacts.name: Financial Technology
impacts.why: Expanding merchant touchpoints supports higher user engagement and higher payment transaction volumes.
